arcane_sustenance.title: Arcane Sustenance
arcane_sustenance.description: Unlocks Arcane Sustenance (50 mana) on the ability wheel: turn mana into food, restoring 1 hunger shank and 4 saturation each cast

silent_appraisal.title: Silent Appraisal
silent_appraisal.description: Unlocks Silent Appraisal (20 mana, 15 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: send out a crow that circles overhead; while it lives, creatures around you glow

blind_investment.title: Blind Investment
blind_investment.description: Unlocks Blind Investment (15 mana, 15 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: send a crow that blinds whatever it hits

bird_strike.title: Bird Strike
bird_strike.description: Unlocks Bird Strike (20 mana, 15 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: a crow overflowing with energy dives into your target

controlled_collapse.title: Controlled Collapse
controlled_collapse.description: Unlocks Controlled Collapse (40 mana, 40 s cooldown) on the ability wheel: a flock of crows circles overhead for a few seconds, then dives in a barrage of bird strikes
